{| cellpadding="0px" cellspacing="0"
|-
| class="iumb-table-container" | 
{| cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" class="hidable-content"
|-

| class="iumb-main" |

<span class="iumb-message">{{{message|}}}</span>

<span class="iumb-comment">{{{comment|}}}</span>
|}

|}
</div><noinclude>
